expected: F01 answer merge and policy-state semantics must define one canonical owner for accepted answer values, deterministic stale-dependent proposal/default invalidation, and envelope invariants that exclude machine states which otherwise fall through to defensive F01-ERR-014 despite carrying contradictory resolution/default/source semantics.
actual: BCE independent audit of candidate e3ca711c8126fbf5d090571a007840b8e51306e9 found that BS-P1-015 does not define where a clarification answer value is stored after the target policy item becomes USER_EXPLICIT/CONFIRMED. Cursor introduced a server-persisted user_explicit_values sidecar that is not part of StructuredIntentEnvelope or intent_record canonical semantic fields. The same audit found that F01-RQ-003 requires stale proposals to be invalidated after trusted answer merge, but the contract does not freeze the deterministic dependency invalidation transition. A same-class sweep also exposed contradictory but schema-valid states UNRESOLVED+can_default=true and DOMAIN_KNOWN+PROPOSED, both currently reaching defensive F01-ERR-014 instead of being rejected as invalid Envelope states.
